balls.text: he's dragged this length ball from outside off to AB at long-on. As a fielder, you can't ask for an easier catch. Harshal extends his gap at the top of the wicket-taker's charts. No. 26 for him,.
swung away into the leg side, off a thick inside edge towards deep midwicket, but the throw is a good one and Sakariya seems to be in trouble despite the dive. Just about makes it in the end.
goes full and straight, into the blockhole, worked wide of midwicket. Ah, full marks for the thought process!

and make that No. 25! Padikkal has taken a superb catch at deep cover. He ran in a tad early, then realised he had to rush back a hint, did so because the ball was absolutely rocketed by Morris, superbly taken in the end on the move.

wicket No. 24 for Harshal! Riyan's pained existence at the crease is over. Stood deep inside the crease to manufacture the length and go over long-off, but ended up slicing this slower ball to Kohli at extra cover. More pressure on the young man.
beaten by an excellent wide yorker. There's deep point for the carve though
hit hard, down to long-off
drills this to deep cover
attempts a wide yorker but ends up veering it just outside the wide line, Morris backed away to swing and couldn't reach out despite his reach in the end
Slower ball but a full toss and put away! Morris walks across and helps this into the gap at deep square. Siraj went for a slower yorker, the ball appeared to have slipped out of his hand
that's a stunner of a stop from Kohli! Morris absolutely belted that on the up as he made room, Kohli threw himself full-length to his left and stopped that on the half-volley. Great effort
squeezes this down to deep point
slaps this into the gap but deep cover runs around to cut that off, good work by Garton to keep it to a single
squeezes this down to long-off
rolls his wrists nicely over the ball as he helps this down to deep backward square, sliding stop by Garton to save two runs
tried to cut but missed this incoming slower delivery, tried to premeditate

just through Bharat, terrific effort though!  Slower and fuller, Morris gives this the kitchen sink, gets a thick edge that has Bharat throwing himself to his right like a goal keeper, but he couldn't hold on.
right into the blockhole, squirted to mid-off.
mistimes a swat to cover
off a thickish inside edge towards square leg, what a spell from Chahal!
tossed up and lands this on a length away from his hitting arc, Parag has a flirt with the idea of a six but lets this pass
struck on the pad as this drifts in and skids through but it would've missed leg. Parag hurried into the stroke as he tried to work it around his front pad. Lovely bowling this.
pushed through quicker outside off, punched down to long-off.
tossed up and he's swung this straight down long-on's throat. Brave from Chahal to toss it up but he did so away from Livingstone's hitting arc. Beautiful bowling, simply superb.
shortish outside off, pulled to deep square leg
steered wide of short third for a quick single
tossed up and drifting into middle and leg, worked to deep midwicket
touch short, he rocks back and slaps it to deep cover
slaps this to sweeper cover
tucks this into the gap between midwicket and long-on
steps out but Shahbaz bowls this a tad wide, he reaches out to punch to sweeper cover
skiddy delivery on middle, works it around his pads, gets bat on it towards midwicket
eased down to long-off to get off the mark
slider on middle, he goes right back and across as he pushes it into the cover region
lunges forward and squirts this back to the bowler
googly outside off, he gets well forward and defends with an angled bat
off the pad and into the leg side, they scamper a leg bye

swept uppishly but he's gone! Deep backward square takes a tumbling catch. Extra bounce from Shahbaz because of his height, Tewatia hit it finer than he would've hoped for because it went off the top-edge. Padikkal is the man again.
punched down to long-off, sensible stuff
tucked wide of short fine
works this down to wide long-on to get off the mark
flatter one on middle and leg, tucked wide of square leg

goes over cover but he's picked out the sweeper. Padikkal barely had to move. Samson hardly got to the pitch but went through with the stroke, it didn't help that he was hitting it to the longer boundary. Royals are sliding.
saved by an inside-edge as he looks to work it to the leg side. Was nicely tossed up again by Chahal on middle. the confidence in his bowling shows.

slides this one across and gets him with the googly! Lomror is looking to whack this over wide long-on, has a big swing but couldn't connect. Didn't even bother looking back. Chahal is making quite a statement
fullish on middle and leg, worked to deep midwicket
slaps this shortish delivery to deep cover
looks to reverse sweep, but Chahal drifts this into middle and leg, mistimed wide of cover
steps out and whips it to deep midwicket
short, he swivels back and hammers this pull to clear deep backward square leg. Quick hands, lovely hand-eye coordination
bunts this down to point
rises with the bounce and fends it into the point region
chopped down to third man to get off the mark
sways out of the line of this short ball bowled way outside off
uses the pace to steer this nicely to square third man, sliding stop by Chahal
top-edge and there's his first wicket! Lewis looks to pull but gets a thick, fat top-edge. KS Bharat called for it, covered good ground to his right and kept his composure to complete the steepler.
lofted inside-out over deep extra cover,  that's a Sanju Samson special!  Not an extravagant flourish but once again, the timing is magnificent. Yuzi missed his length by not much.
tucks this off a length on middle and leg to square leg
wrong'un on a length, tucked with the spin to fine leg
drifting into middle and leg, tucked into the leg side
rocks back to pull, lands just short of Maxwell at deep midwicket. Flat hit, he had to take a split-second decision: go for the catch or stop the boundary? Tried both.
googly on leg-stump, defended as he covers the line
back of a length outside off stump. Offers no shot, through to the keeper again
over the stumps. Full just outside off. Samson presses forward to defend this ball. But it goes past the edge to the keeper
full ball outside off. A tentative pushed to long off for a single

easy pickings! Patel offers a freebie, and Lewis takes it like a child in a toy shop. Back of a length on middle and angling down leg. Lewis simply turns, and whips it over short fine leg for a one-bounce four
good length outside off and he hammers a pull along the ground. Beats the two fielders on the boundary on the leg side and that's Lewis' first Rajasthan Royals fifty! So quick to get in position
good length ball outside off. Punched towards point, but can't get the gap

wayward ball. Around the stumps. Full outside leg stump, and going down the leg side of course. Bharat, one of India's best domestic keepers, dives to his right and ensures that does not go away for more runs. One-handed dive!
around the stumps. Full ball on off and he mows a shot to midwicket with minimal effort
back of a length outside off. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
full just outside off. Brings the bat forward and gently drives through the covers. Man at deep extra cover needs to run around and intercept
full on off and tapped back to the bowler off the front foot

partnership broken for 77! Full ball on off. In the slot too, but Jaiswal is through the attempted lofted shot a bit too early. Mistimed, and can't clear Siraj at mid off! Probably the correct method to play today. Good pitch, some big-hitters in the shed. But Christian has broken what was turning into a very large partnership

slower ball to start off. But it's a wide ball in the slot. Jaiswal extends his arms to adjust for the lack of pace, and then does that flourishing followthrough to ensure the ball travels upwards despite the non-perfect timing
full outside off stump. Big stride forward and smothers a shot back to Maxwell. Just four off that over
good length on middle. Swivels and pulls along the ground. Struck behind square, and Siraj at deep midwicket has to run around the boundary line to intercept
good length on middle. Uses his wrists to flick it through midwicket for a easy single
full on off stump. Looks to punch down the ground but inside edged onto his body
good length outside off. Taps a gentle cut to point. Plays with soft hands, and that allows him to pinch the single
around the stumps. Length ball angling in. Punched off the back foot to mid off
cute! cheeky! calculated! Full on off and middle. Jaiswal walks across to the off side, opens his stance, and then simply scoops it over Patel at third man. Christian leaking some runs

no man's land! Length ball on off. Lewis looks to pull that into orbit, but deceived by the slower ball again. Mistimed, off the top half of the bat, and would've been out if there was a fielder at mid on
good length ball on middle. And angling into leg. Jaiswal comes down the ground and taps it to Siraj at cover. Jaiswal takes the fielder on, but he misses the direct hit
scythes it away! Slower ball, length delivery. Angling into leg stump. Jaiswal backs away, make extra room, and then cuts it hard. More importantly, cuts it past point and far enough from third man
another cutter. Length ball outside off, and Lewis muscles a cut in front of square. Man in the deep though
slower ball. Good length outside off. Lewis looks to cut behind square but is deceived by the change of pace. Past the edge to Bharat
Jaiswal will be disappointed on missing out. Back of a length on middle and angling across. Jaiswal tries to cut/ramp it towards third man but failed to get any bat. Time out too
yorker attempted, around off stump. Jaiswal moves to the leg side to make some room and then toe-ends a drive to the off side
yorker, well directed. But Jaiswal is up to the challenge. Brings the bat down swiftly, and bunts it away to cover for a quick run
good length on middle, and he waits for the ball to get to him before playing a very cute late cut. Patel at third man cleans up
pushed towards mid off
good length on middle and leg. Hurries into Jaiswal. Uncomfortably tucked away to square leg
slower ball bouncer to end the over. Back of a length outside leg but ends up going over Lewis' shoulder while he ducks
golf swing! Lewis doesn't need a second invitation. Slot ball on middle and leg. Slower one too. Lewis clears the front leg, and simply razes the bat through the ball's line. Hit over long on
over the stumps. Length ball on leg and moving into middle and off. Tries to punch down the ground. Inside edge to square leg
back of a length slower ball. Angling into him and he drags a grounded pull to the sweeper-fielder on the leg side

sliced over third man! Patel comes from wide of the crease, while being around the stumps. Short, width offered, and he throws his bat at it with hard hands. Probably didn't go in the intended area, but he'll take 'em
around the stumps. Starts off with the yorker that is also the slower ball. Driven to mid off for a quick single

well stopped! Maxwell behind it. Slot ball just outside off. And Lewis walks into a drive that is struck very hard. In the air slightly, and lands just in front of Maxwell who was moving to his right at mid on

mauled! Back of a length, wide outside off, not quick enough. Lewis keeps a stable base and absolutely hammers a pull over deep midwicket. These dragged pulls can be dangerous but this has been hit beautifully
full ball, but pace taken off. Outside off, and Lewis mistimes the attempted cut. Thick edge and it goes past short third man for four more!
short ball outside off. Pulled along the ground to midwicket. Chahal is there, but it bursts through him. Extra runs
deposited! Short ball, not quick enough though. Lewis makes his top-half contort to the leg side as he pulls it over midwicket for a biggie

length ball outside off. Turning away. Another opportunity for Jaiswal to hit it for four. But the well-struck cut finds Shahbaz at point. Shahbaz throws it to the keeper Bharat, and Bharat knocks the bails off. Interestingly, Jaiswal's back leg was perhaps in the air at the moment.
fullish outside off. Turning away, and tapped to mid off. But Kohli runs across from cover and tries to create a run-out but he misfields
in the gap! Length ball outside off. Lewis rocks back in his crease, earns that extra time to play the shot, and punches it with the bat's open face past the point fielder
good length on off. Punched off the back foot to Kohli's left at cover. But he runs square and dives to intercept what could've been a few more runs
full ball, just outside off. But Jaiswal is not intimidated by the ball that can turn away. Down on one knee, big stride forward, and hammered over wide long on for six
around the stumps. On off, and swept to deep backward square leg for one
full on middle, and he punches past cover's right for four to end the over! Still head, stands tall, and then meets the ball from near his eyeline
good length ball outside leg stump and angling into his chest region. Rides the bounce and blocks with soft hands. Siraj pushed Jaiswal back this time with the bounce
Siraj doing it again. Length ball, on middle and angling across Jaiswal. Another cut missed. Ball goes over the bat. Extra bounce, perhaps from the fresh pitch
good length outside off. Extra bounce, angling away. Looks to cut but misses. Could've nicked that, a dangerous shot option with ther slip cordon in play
good length ball outside off stump. Angling further away. Left alone. Through to the keeper
full just outside off. Bit of movement into the batter, and he muscles a slog to midwicket who is standing on the circle
overpitched, nearly a yorker around off. Toe-ends a shot to mid off
pulled and in the air. But short of Padikkal at deep midwicket. Padikkal suggests that he didn't spot the ball in time. Good length ball and Lewis looked to swat that for a boundary
full outside off. Just a bit of swing away from Lewis. He covers his off stump and shoulders his arms
good length just outside off. Angling into off stump and Lewis shuffles across to the off side to defend
full toss on off stump. Lewis looks to drive it past the non-striker but mistimed to mid off instead. Garton gets away with that one
length ball to start off. Moving away. Lewis gently cuts it through the gap between point and cover point. Pierces the gap and gets two

there you go! RCB win their second game in a row . That keeps them at third. What happened to the ball? AB walks across and sweeps this off a length from outside off to find the deep square leg boundary.  RCB's run rate gets a lift too
shovelled down the ground to beat long-on! Maxwell gets to his half-century off just 30 balls, RCB one away. Raises his bat to a delighted dug out.
the top-edge flies over the keeper's head, can't set a field for that!
mows it into the gap at deep midwicket, Livingstone with a sliding stop. It was a slower ball, looks like Maxwell wanted to hit it a lot straighter
swung away to the fine leg boundary! Friendly bowling from Morris. Short and feeding into Maxwell's strengths by angling it in, he swivelled back and simply helped it along to beat fine leg.
edged and races away to third man, good work by Sakariya. Maxwell went for a bullet drive, got a thick bottom edge
there was a bit of needle between these two earlier, Maxwell gives him a glare now as he whips this length ball over deep midwicket. Bottom-handed power
Bharat has pulled this straight to fine leg. This one got big on him as he shaped to pull, also skidded through faster, so Bharat got it higher on the bat. Good innings nonetheless.
whips this into the leg side for a quick single
length ball on middle, deviates away off the pitch, Maxwell can't pick the gap as he works it back to the bowler.
slower length ball, punched to sweeper cover
tucks this gently into the leg side
slower and fuller, punched down to long-off
goes wide of the crease and slants one across, steered to deep point
up and over cover! Short of length outside off, Maxwell made room and slapped it over
slower length ball, Bharat guides it to point
slower and fuller on leg stump, pushed down to long-on
beaten as he tries to make room and slap this length ball behind point
lofted one bounce to the extra cover boundary! Sakariya went length as he slanted it across, Maxwell used the width to swing it up and over.
punched down to wide long-on once again
flatter one on middle and leg, punched to long-on
fired full, Bharat plays a fine reverse lap to beat short third. This is lovely batting. Touch game that has Kohli wildly cheering from the dug out
looks to muscle this over long-on, no timing. Couple of bounces to Parag
lunges forward and bunts it wide of cover
fired full, squeezed to long-off
slower length ball on off, punched to deep point
full toss angling in, flicked straight to midwicket.
slower full toss, whips this down to deep midwicket
where has that gone? Deep into the stands at backward square leg. Gets down on one knee, goes underneath the delivery and slog sweeps him imperiously.
attempts to mow this leg side but sees this bowled wide outside off, so he gets down on one knee and chips it over extra cover for a couple
length on middle, punched to long-on
swung across the line to long-on, didn't get the elevation
plays it late, behind point. Was cramped for room but somehow managed to get enough bat on that
belts this full delivery to sweeper cover
fired down leg as he sees Maxwell trying to make room, good stop by Samson, wide called
fired full on off, squeezed straight to cover
drifting into middle and leg, bunts this towards deep midwicket
steps out and lofts him through the line even though this is bowled into the pitch, he bisects long-off and long-on. Packed a punch!
width outside off and Maxwell swats this superbly as he opens the bat face a hint, beats the man running around from deep point. Tremendous
steps out, Tewatia sees him coming and drops short, Bharat punches it uppishly to long-off
fullish on middle and leg, whipped to long-on
steps out and pushes it down to long-on
beaten as he misses an attempted slog sweep
punches this shortish delivery to cover
full on middle, and clipped to midwicket
fullish on off. Skips down the ground and bunts it to cover
full toss on middle and leg. Comfortably flicked through midwicket to the man on the boundary
lbw shout but this is going down the leg side. Length ball from around the stumps angles into his pads
good length outside off. Stays on the back foot and punches it to cover's right
full toss on middle, and swiped to deep midwicket for a single
pushed to mid on

Mustafizur saves five runs! Ridiculous. Short ball on off, and Maxwell tries to pull again. Top-edged, looks like it's soaring over fine leg for six. But Mustafizur jumps on the line, and volleyball-swats the ball back into the field of play!

just beyond Jaiswal at deep square leg! Full marks for commitment but the effort doesn't come with a wicket. Maxwell pulls this short ball, but it's off the top half of the blade. Goes behind square instead of in front. Jaiswal runs around from deep square leg to dive and take a catch, but just beyond him
full toss on off stump. Pushed to mid off's right for a quick run
full and wide. Slapped away to deep point. Just one though
full and wide outside off. Maxwell looks to drive but the ball moves away. Past the outside edge to the keeper
good length ball outside off stump. Sticks the bat out and runs it down to third man
full on middle. Skips down the ground and drives it to long on
full on middle. Full face of the bat as he pushes it back
full just outside off stump. Turning away and pushed back to Tewatia
good length on off. He swivels and pulls a shot from well inside the crease. In the gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg!
good length on off stump. Nudged off his pads to midwicket
full just outside off stump. Nudged towards cover point, and its a single on offer for Bharat
back of a length outside off. Looks to pull from outside off, and nearly pays the price for it. Mis-hit in the air, but falls beyond the square-leg umpire

good length outside off stump. Opens the bat's face to backward point. Parag dives, stops the ball, and then takes aim at the bowler's end! Beautiful...it's a direct hit, and Kohli may be out trying to take a single off a misfield. Replays show Kohli is short by a metre or two! Kohli pays the price of taking on Parag's arm
length ball angling in. Worked off his pads to square leg for a single
fullish outside off. Slaps a cut behind square. In the air but goes to Riyan Parag's left! Just about carried to Parag, who moved to his left to take the catch
good length ball angling into his body. And flicked off his waist to deep backward square leg
cutter first up. Back of a length outside off and coming into him. Tapped with soft hands to he off side, and off they go for a single
slower ball. Full on middle, and the last ball of the powerplay is flicked to deep midwicket. Are they taking three? Can be risky...but Kohli pulls it off with some help from Bharat

peach of a ball from the Fizz. Full on off stump. Kohli presses forward to hammer a flick through midwicket but the ball goes straight through. Past the bat-pad gap, and just past the outside of off stump
full just outside off stump. Waits for it before guiding a shot to third man for one

full just outside off. Toe-ends the drive past the non-striker. Mid off is late to react and can't stop the shot with a die either. Mid on runs to the boundary line and drags the ball back. Miller is on the field as a sub fielder right now

bowled him! Padikkal falls, and this is the first Rajasthan Royals wicket against RCB this season. Full on off stump. Looks to hammer it over the bowler's head again like the last ball. This time the ball is moving in instead of away. Past the bat, and knocks off stump back
full outside off. Looks to clobber a shot over the bowler's head. But the ball jags away, and goes past the outside edge
fullish outside off stump. Defended towards cover point, but no chance of a single
full on off and nudged off the pads to deep square leg
finally the cut comes off! Good length outside off. He stays on the back foot, and slaps a shot between the small gap between short third man and point
making Padikkal poke at it. Good length ball outside off, but he can't get bat on ball. Fizzes through to the keeper
short ball, and that's too short. Goes way over Padikkal's head with him offering no shot
full outside off, and he smothers a drive through the infield. Man in the deep though
full outside off stump. Kohli moves to the off side but mistimes the late cut. Rolls away to short third man
slower ball. Full on middle, and angling down leg. But he misses the flick, and it hits the pad before rolling away to fine leg. Lewis and Sakariya give the ball a chase and stop the four
full outside off stump. Bends the knee and drills a drive. Past cover's right, Jaiswal could not get a hand to it. Sweet sound off the bat
full, nearly a yorker just outside leg stump. Dug away

drags a pull from way outside off. Enough in the shot to beat Morris at mid on too! Races away to wide long on for another boundary. Short ball outside off from Mustafizur, and not quick enough to trouble Padikkal
good length outside off stump. Cuts it to backward point. But not in the gap
full just outside off. Comes down the ground and looks to hammer it over long off. Mistimed, and in the air, but goes just over mid off. Lands safe
good length outside off, and nudged to backward point for a single

that doesn't help! Dropped. Its the inswinger. Length ball, jagging in sharply. Padikkal looks to cut but its very close to his body. Edged, and Samson has to move to his left to take the catch. But fluffs it. Came to Samson fast, but Sakariya should've had a wicket
good length outside off. Sticks the bat out and guides a shot to short third man
good length on off. Angling across. Runs it down to point's left for a single
full on off stump. Mistimed the flick to midwicket. No run on offer though
full on off. Skips down the ground and thumps a drive to cover. Jaiswal dives to his right, and cuts it off
full on middle, and flicked through square leg. Lewis at deep backward square leg runs around the boundary line and cuts it off
full and wide outside off stump. Goes over the infield and gets it over Morris inside the circle. Couple of bounces for four
full on off, and he cracks a flicky shot to mid on
back of a length outside off. Angling away further. Kohli looks to cut it over point but can't connect
overpitched just outside off stump. Guided towards short third man for a single
driven through covers! Full just outside off stump, and struck for four! Bat's angle at 45 degrees, and that helps him pierce the gap
yorker length, but outside leg stump. Clipped off his toes, and that's played very fine.
good length ball on off stump. Defended towards the leg side. But no chance of a run
pulled with disdain! Short ball angling into him, and he plays this off the front foot. Uses his wrists to keep total control over the shot. Played to midwicket
back of a length outside off stump. Offers no shot as the ball keeps rising through
lucky! Full on middle, and he looks to flick it over midwicket. Late movement off the deck takes the ball away, and ends up taking a leading edge over the slip cordon for four!
full outside off stump from Morris. Wants to drive through cover but mistimed back to the bowler
